questions.q: Which two cities does the great railroad line connect?
choices: San Francisco and New York
Chicago and Los Angeles
Boston and San Diego
Omaha and Sacramento only
questions.evidence: New York and San Francisco are thus united

questions.q: How long did the trip from New York to San Francisco now take by railroad?
choices: About six months
Seven days
Three full weeks
Two days and a night
questions.evidence: It is now accomplished in seven days.

questions.q: According to the chapter, how fast did the railroad grow across the prairies while it was being built?
choices: Ten miles every single week
A mile and a half a day
Half a mile in each month
Five miles on a good day
questions.evidence: The road grew, on the prairies, a mile and a half a day.

questions.q: What did Phileas Fogg hope to catch at New York on the 11th?
choices: A fast train going north to Canada
The Atlantic steamer for Liverpool
A river boat down to New Orleans
A mail ship sailing across to France
questions.evidence: take the Atlantic steamer at New York on the 11th for Liverpool

questions.q: How did Passepartout feel toward Fix as they sat together on the train?
choices: He was glad to have a friend to talk with
He felt sorry that Fix seemed so lonely
He was cold and ready to strangle him
He was afraid Fix would leave the train
questions.evidence: ready to strangle his former friend on the slightest provocation

questions.q: What happened in the car at eight o'clock on the first night?
choices: The passengers were served a large dinner
The car was turned into a dormitory of beds
A conductor came to check every ticket
The lamps were put out to save the oil
questions.evidence: the car was transformed into a dormitory

questions.q: The track went "plunging into narrow defiles, which seemed to have no outlet." What is a defile here?
choices: A narrow pass between mountains
A wide and grassy open meadow
A long bridge over a deep, rushing river
A tall wooden station platform

questions.q: What blocked the train's track about twelve o'clock in Nevada?
choices: A huge snowdrift
A broken bridge
A herd of buffalo
A fallen pine tree
questions.evidence: a troop of ten or twelve thousand head of buffalo encumbered the track

questions.q: How did Phileas Fogg act while the train was stopped by the delay?
choices: He paced the platform and scolded the engineer
He stayed in his seat and waited calmly
He wrote angry letters to the railroad company
He walked ahead to try to find another train
questions.evidence: remained in his seat, and waited philosophically

questions.q: Why was the engineer wise not to drive the locomotive straight through the herd?
choices: The animals belonged to a rich rancher nearby
The law said trains must always stop for cattle
The train could have been thrown off the track
The passengers wanted time to watch the herd
questions.evidence: the train would inevitably have been thrown off the track

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: Fogg and his party crossing the West by train, including a long buffalo delay
Passepartout and Fix fighting on the train and being put off the train at Reno
Fogg buying a ranch in Nevada so he can rest from his long journey
The travellers losing their way in a snowstorm in the Sierra Nevada
questions.evidence: The procession of buffaloes lasted three full hours
